verified: edh-mana-keywords-9 review (Commander lane edh-mana-keywords; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27), EDHREC 1695), by hand against the Oracle text: the enters trigger's optional exile of a land you control is linked (CR 607.2a: the exiling instruction records 'exiled'); the second ability triggers on a mana ability of any land with the same name as the exiled card (CR 201.2; a trigger on every player's land, CR 605.1b, 106.12), and the land's controller adds one mana of any type that land produced (CR 106.3, 106.4, 109.5) (trg.edhmk9.landSameNameExiled.tappedForMana, eff.t38.mana.producedType.player)

edh-mana-keywords-9 review (Commander lane edh-mana-keywords; tuning half, EDHREC 1332), by hand against the Oracle text and the ruling of 2004-10-04: a triggered ability (not a mana ability) at the beginning of each of its controller's main phases with a target opponent chosen as it triggers; the option to add X mana of one color, X the number of Islands that opponent controls as it resolves; the clause 'if you haven't added mana with this ability this turn' is the once-each-turn limit on taking the option (CR 603.2h, 603.4, 106.4, 115.1), counted when the option is taken (limit.action), so a declined option leaves the second main phase its turn (cond.if-less; lower/ability.ts NOT_ADDED_MANA_TEXT, ch.may)

edh-mana-keywords-9 review (Commander lane edh-mana-keywords; held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27), EDHREC 3666), by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings of 2022-06-10: the trigger fires once for each roll of dice by its controller (CR 603.2c, 706.2) and puts that many charge counters on the artifact (the result of one roll is the total of the dice not ignored); the tap ability adds one mana of any color and rolls a d20 at once as a mana ability (CR 605.1a, 605.3b: a mana ability may do more than add mana); the third ability removes 100 counters as a cost (CR 122.1, 701.23, 701.24, 400.1)

edh-mana-keywords-9 review (Commander lane edh-mana-keywords; tuning half, EDHREC 1445), by hand against the Oracle text and the rulings of 2010-03-01 and 2024-11-08: Multikicker {1}; as the spell is cast any target (an object or a player) is chosen and one more different target for each time it was kicked (CR 601.2c, 115.3, 702.33c: the kicks are announced before the targets), and it deals X damage to each of them, the targets still legal as it resolves (CR 608.2b, 120.3f) (eff.edhmk9.choose.anyTarget.thenAnotherPerKick)
